Quotes / paraphrases:

POC focus: quantify CPU/GPU costs with different quant profiles (8-bit vs 4-bit), measure savings from prefix/KV caching for repeated UI prompts, tune batch sizing to meet 95th-percentile latency SLO.

POC acceptance criteria (agreed):
- Latency: median <150ms for 80% of short chat responses, 95th <300ms for typical sessions.
- Cost: <$0.02 per active session (est. definition: 200 tokens avg) or unit economics equivalent depending on quant/profile.
- Security: VPC + customer-managed KMS + SOC2 evidence for Dedicated/private control plane.

Next immediate actions: schedule 2-hour optimization workshop; provide baseline hosted bill simulation; prepare Dedicated pricing scenarios with committed units and burst policy.
poc_summary: Started with Hosted API sandbox -> verified functional features (tool-calls, streaming, embeddings). Now running small Dedicated POC: 2-node pool with A100 equivalent for 72-hour run to measure batching and KV cache benefits. POC will run three model variants: open-70b (fp16), open-70b-8bit, and open-70b-4bit-quant. Goal: measure latency, throughput, and token cost delta across quant levels.
cost_requirements: Finance wants clear per-1M-token unit cost and per-session example for 100k DAU profile. Interested in: batching gains, KV/prefix cache hit rate impact, storage cost for cache, expected uplift if quantized to 4-bit with minimal quality regression.
technical_reqs: Targets: 95th percentile latency <300ms for chat; throughput target 50 QPS sustained with bursts to 120 QPS; embeddings pipeline must handle 5k reqs/min during index rebuild windows. Must support SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS; VPC connectivity required for Dedicated deployment.
